prompt.zh-TW: 阿豪的「藍鯨水族」這個月有下面幾筆現金進出。每一筆屬於營業、投資還是籌資活動？把卡片放進正確的格子。
prompt.en: Hao’s shop Blue Whale Aquatics had the following cash movements this month. Is each one an operating, investing or financing activity? Put each card in the right box.

text.zh-TW: 收到客人買魚缸付的現金
text.en: Cash received from a customer buying a fish tank

text.zh-TW: 用現金買一台會用好幾年的大型冷水機
text.en: Cash paid for a large chiller that will be used for years

text.zh-TW: 向銀行借入一筆一年內要還的錢
text.en: Cash borrowed from the bank, repayable within a year

text.zh-TW: 付給飼料供應商的貨款
text.en: Cash paid to the fish-food supplier
Further capital put in by the shareholders

text.zh-TW: 付這個月店裡用掉的事務用品費
text.en: Cash paid for the office supplies used in the shop this month

explanation.zh-TW: 先問這筆錢和「做生意本身」有沒有關：收貨款、付貨款、付日常開銷都是{{term:tm_p2a7c5vk}}。買會用好幾年的設備是{{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}。向銀行借款、股東出資這類向資金提供者取得資金的收付是{{term:tm_f9a4c6md}}：借款與股東出資都讓現金進來，但都不是賺來的。
explanation.en: First ask whether the cash is about running the business itself: collecting from customers, paying suppliers and paying day-to-day costs are all {{term:tm_p2a7c5vk}}. Buying equipment that will serve for years is {{term:tm_9hrfpqem}}. Raising funds from providers of funds, such as borrowing from the bank or taking in capital from shareholders, is {{term:tm_f9a4c6md}}: the loan and the new capital both bring cash in, but neither was earned.
